reviews.title: Close AS2 Areas 4-6 Stage.wmodeGPU and TextRenderer plus Area 7 NetStream.getInfo
reviews.summary: Wires Stage.wmodeGPU across Rust ScriptAS2Stage and GPU layer promotion, exposes flash.text.TextRenderer (displayMode, maxLevel, setAdvancedAntialiasingTable) with continuous stroke modulation, and upgrades NetStream.getInfo() with rolling/peak byte rates, channel/data byte counts, buffer lengths, and dropped-frame snapshots.

entries.note: Read-only Boolean property on Stage backed by ScriptAS2Stage configure_gpu: returns false on 2D Canvas/DOM and true when GPU/WebGL wmode compositing is active.
Exposes flash.text.TextRenderer in AS2 publications and _global.flash.text.TextRenderer backed by shared Rust TextRendererState and CSM interpolation.
Reads and sets static TextRenderer.displayMode ('default', 'lcd', 'crt') validated by Rust TextRendererState and drives LCD RGB subpixel and CRT bloom text rendering.
Reads and sets static TextRenderer.maxLevel clamped to 0..64 (default 4), disabling stroke smoothing at 0 and scaling antialiasing passes with higher levels.
Stores per-font/style/colorType (dark or light) CSM cutoff tables in Rust and interpolates insideCutoff/outsideCutoff by font size and text luminance when rendering advanced TextFields.

Returns live ScriptAS2Stream playback snapshots including rolling and peak bytes/sec, playbackBytesPerSecond, audio/video/data byte counts and buffer lengths, droppedFrames, srtt, uri, resourceName, and isLive.
